title: Marathon Handbook — Records Shattered at the 2025 Leadville Trail 100 (press report, not official results PDF)
claims: At the 2025 Leadville Trail 100 Run, David Roche won the men's race in 15:12:30, improving the men's course record he set in 2024.
Anne Flower won the women's race in 17:58:19, placing second overall and breaking Ann Trason's 31-year-old women's record of 18:06:24 set in 1994; the report describes it as her 100-mile debut.
